drawer.roleTip: Teacher, Mentor and Auditor access are independent. Teacher and Mentor may overlap. Transfer all courses before removing Teacher access or deleting an account; Mentor access does not require Teacher access.

dialog.changeRoleContent: Are you sure you want to {action} the "{role}" role for {username}?
dialog.banContent: Are you sure you want to {action} {username}? {warning}
dialog.deleteContent: Are you sure you want to delete user {username}? Deleted users cannot log in and will no longer appear in lists or the front-end. Historical data is retained (recoverable from the database).

permissions.summary: Six parallel groups; Teacher and Mentor may overlap. Every group has Student permissions. Only Operators and Admins bypass publication review; courses do not require review.
permissions.operator: One account only, with all permissions, including system information and Admin creation.
permissions.admin: Created by the Operator. Has management, review, course, messaging and publication bypass permissions, without access to system information.
permissions.auditor: Can review other users' content and has all Student permissions. Own content still requires review.
permissions.teacher: Can upload course videos and receive and reply to Student messages, with all Student permissions.
permissions.mentor: Can receive and send messages, with all Student permissions. Mentor access alone does not allow course creation.
permissions.student: Can publish posts and replies and contact Teachers or Mentors, but cannot initiate messages to other Students.
permissions.dedicated: Operators and Admins inherit all member capabilities without separate Teacher, Mentor or Auditor grants.

temporaryPasswordTip: The Admin must change this password at first login. Management accounts cannot become members.
